final: WITH hand_counts AS (SELECT p.throws, COUNT(*) AS award_count FROM manager_award AS ma JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id GROUP BY p.throws), shares AS (SELECT throws, award_count, 1.0 * award_count / SUM(award_count) OVER () AS share FROM hand_counts), qualifying AS (SELECT award_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT SUM(award_count) AS total_counts, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess FROM qualifying WHERE share > average_share
